import json
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/APPLE_2016_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
for i,x in enumerate(data.get('texts',[])[:80]):
    t=x.get('text','')
    if 'exact name of registrant' in t.lower() or 'registrant' in t.lower():
        print(i, x.get('page_no'), repr(t[:500]))
PY"
